type: M11 PRE-REGISTRATION -- three confirmatory arms closing reviewer objections
motivation: Five objections were identified against the current results. Three are testable and are fixed here; one (baseline strength) is a measurement change with no directional hypothesis; one (framing) needs no experiment. Directions are fixed BEFORE any cell runs.

arm_W5_latent_confounding.objection: scm_prior_control restricts the label to observed nodes, so the in-prior anchor lacks the latent confounding present in TabPFN's real prior.
arm_W5_latent_confounding.fix: scm_latent_confounded: a DISCRETE latent Z drives both the feature distribution and the decision rule, so p(y|x) = sum_z p(y|x,z) p(z|x) is an exact finite sum. Genuine confounding AND an exact oracle, with no Monte Carlo error.
arm_W5_latent_confounding.H_W5: TabPFN's Bayes regret on scm_latent_confounded remains LOW (comparable to the restricted anchor, and well below the out-of-prior families such as high_frequency). Direction fixed: we predict the anchor SURVIVES confounding. If regret rises sharply instead, that is a finding about where the recovered prior stops matching, and will be reported as such rather than reframed.
arm_W5_latent_confounding.test: paired comparison of TabPFN regret on scm_prior_control vs scm_latent_confounded at matched d, n_classes, n_train, 5 seeds.

arm_W1_scale_ladder.objection: n was capped at 1500-4000 while TabPFN v2 is rated to ~10k rows, so the evaluation sat outside the model's stated operating range.
arm_W1_scale_ladder.fix: paired rotation probe at n_train in [500, 2000, 10000] on low-dimensional real datasets with enough rows; 10000 is TabPFN v2's stated ceiling.
arm_W1_scale_ladder.H_W1: The paired degradation stays POSITIVE at every level, including n=10000. A significant positive Spearman(n_train, degradation) means the earlier cap UNDERSTATED the effect; negative means it overstated it. Both reportable; the pre-registered claim is only that the effect survives at all three levels.
arm_W1_scale_ladder.exclusions: datasets with >10 classes (TabPFN v2 hard limit) are dropped by rule, e.g. Food_Delivery_Time (45 classes).

arm_armC_fix.objection: SELF-IDENTIFIED DEFECT. M10 arm C permuted categorical codes but never passed categorical_features_indices, so TabPFN saw ordinal codes as plain numbers. The existing result is therefore a PREPROCESSING finding, not a statement about TabPFN's prior.
arm_armC_fix.fix: add the declared-categorical condition, giving a 2x2: {declared, undeclared} x {original, permuted}. The undeclared half is already cached.
arm_armC_fix.H_armC: If the permutation effect PERSISTS when categoricals are declared, it is a property of the model. If it VANISHES, the original arm C measured only the cost of not declaring them -- a sharp preprocessing warning, and the earlier claim must be restated. We do not predict which; both are reported, and the M10 arm C wording will be corrected either way.

analysis_plan: each arm reported on its own n
no arm pooled into M9 primary or replication results
